messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — high traffic surge detected in eu-west economy lane. 95th latency 820ms, error rate (5m) up 14% -> customer-facing 429s. Affected tenants: RetailCo (rc-42), DocFlow (df-88). Escalation: on-call SRE.
emma: I'm on-call. Joining Zoom now. tagging @sam for platform context.
sam: I see the spike, looks like economy lane weight jumped due to batching change. Suggest immediate traffic shepherd: pin critical tenants to premium lane + temporary per-tenant soft-rate bump for DocFlow.
raj: If we pin them to premium we risk capacity pressure on premium GPUs. Can we instead do regional pin (eu-west premium only) and raise quota there? Less blast radius.
olivia: I can push a steer rule. Proposed payload:
```
POST /routing/steer
{
  "tenants": ["rc-42","df-88"],
  "target_lane": "premium",
  "region": "eu-west",
  "ttl": "15m",
  "reason": "live mitigation - economy surge"
}
```
emma: Go ahead, but coordinate with deploy-bot for audit and with @devops-bot to ensure autoscaler watch.
deploy-bot: Approval required from @sam for premium steer affecting reserved capacity. Please confirm.
sam: Approved. Olivia proceed.
olivia: Applying steer now.
devops-bot: ACTION OK — steer applied (id: steer-20260315-01). Audit: olivia@redwood. Routing config version v12.7 -> v12.8. Autoscaler watch started.
emma: Rolling monitor: p50/p95/p99 on dashboard https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/steer-incident. Will report 2m cadence.
raj: Also applying temporary quota bump for df-88: `quota:set df-88 --region eu-west --mult 2 --ttl 15m` to reduce 429s.
devops-bot: Quota change applied (id: quota-20260315-01). New per-minute: 1200 -> 2400.
sam: Early signals: 429s for RetailCo down ~68%, DocFlow 429s down ~84%. p95 latency for tenants reduced to 210-250ms. Good.
emma: Customers reached out? Support shows one active ticket from RetailCo; CS alerted. No wide customer-reported incidents yet.
raj: Cost note: premium lane uses larger instances — expect short spike in infra spend. Revert plan: evaluate in 15m and remove steer if stable.
olivia: I will keep the steer TTL at 15m and set automated revert unless we extend.
emma: Next: create follow-up task to investigate why economy batching delta caused sudden weight change. Owner: raj.
sam: Also add runbook step: validate RL thresholds for queueing in smart-router. I'll file a postmortem action.
emma: Handoff: On-call shifting at 09:00 UTC to @raj. I'll annotate incident timeline and handoff notes in the incident doc.
incident-bot: PAGERSILENCE by emma at 08:47 UTC. Monitoring continues. Close pager? react :white_check_mark: .
emma: Closing pager for now, will re-open if metrics regress. Good work team. :thumbsup:
